function_declarations.name: get_engine_vocabulary
function_declarations.description: Retrieve the full, strict vocabulary of the Blender Roblox animation engine. Contains all valid character cast presets, 3D sets, set dressings, marks (positions and seating), character poses, facial expressions, motion actions, hand and world props, sound effects (SFX), and music moods. Always call this BEFORE drafting a script or shots.json.

function_declarations.name: create_new_episode
function_declarations.description: Create a new episode workspace containing script.md and shots.json, and run initial validation. Episode ID must begin with 'wi_' (for 'What If' format) or 'itt_' (for 'In This Town' format).

episode_id.description: Unique folder slug in snake_case prefixed by format, e.g., 'wi_zlatan_golden_boot' or 'itt_pizza_chaos'.

title.description: Engaging title of the short video, e.g., 'What If Zlatan Lost His Golden Boot?'.

script_markdown.description: Full markdown beat sheet containing title, logline, cast table, and beat table with numbered lines and speaker tags.

shots_data.description: The complete shot list specification adhering to SHOTLIST_FORMAT.md (including episode, format, title, narrator, music, hook_title, thumbnail, publish, and shots array).

function_declarations.name: validate_shotlist
function_declarations.description: Validate an episode's shots.json against engine vocabulary, camera rules, mark locations, and constraints. Returns error and warning lists. Must achieve 0 errors before rendering.

function_declarations.name: generate_voiceover
function_declarations.description: Synthesize voiceover audio for each dialogue shot using ElevenLabs (or Edge TTS fallback) and calculate precise word-level alignment timestamps stored in timing.json.

episode_path.description: Path to the episode directory, e.g. 'episodes/wi_zlatan_bff'.

function_declarations.name: build_blender_scene
function_declarations.description: Assemble the complete 3D scene in Blender in headless background mode: instantiates sets, rigs R6 characters, applies poses and lip-sync motions, places props, and animates cameras into <episode>.blend.

episode_path.description: Path to the episode directory, e.g. 'episodes/wi_zlatan_bff'.

function_declarations.name: render_contact_sheet
function_declarations.description: Render a visual QA contact sheet (render/contact_sheet.png) showing one labeled still from the middle of each shot. Used to visually check character framing, prop visibility, and staging before full video rendering.

function_declarations.name: render_video_pipeline
function_declarations.description: Execute the full video render and editing pipeline in Blender. Renders 3D frames, combines audio mixes (voice, sfx, music), generates animated karaoke captions, hook title box, and transitions.

final.description: Set to True for full 1080x1920 production render with publishing package; False for fast 540x960 preview.

only_stages.description: Optional comma-separated list of stages to run (e.g. 'raw,edit').

function_declarations.name: render_thumbnail
function_declarations.description: Render the high-CTR YouTube/TikTok cover thumbnail graphic with stylized hook title card text box.

function_declarations.name: inspect_frame
function_declarations.description: Render an exact specific frame from the 3D scene to an image file for inspection.
